name: Tinker
author: Tinker (based on Card Upgrader and Relic Upgrader)
description: Upgrade your cards and relics with gold, and buy the game's enchantments, in the Workshop (click Tinkerer's Dial outside combat). Based on Card Upgrader 0.9.2 and Relic Upgrader 0.5.1; disable those mods while this one is enabled.
